description: Customer reviews of one profile, newest first (rating, text, date, first name and initial). Reviews are written by signed-in users; the directory does not verify that the reviewer hired the person.

language.description: Language of the names and links in the answer (default es).

page.description: Page of reviews, newest first, starting at 1 (default 1).

slug.description: The profile slug, exactly as returned by search_businesses or top_rated (for example "carlos-jimenez").

name: get_business_reviews
